section_summary.extract_value: This section describes a pre-college sample of White adolescent females (admitted first-year college students) recruited from a southeastern U.S. university, with an initial n=94 and a final analytic sample of n=84. Participants completed an online survey (Survey-Share); mean age was 17.9 years (SD=0.37) and mean self-reported BMI was 22.7 (SD=3.9).
